name: Acholi nationalism
notAnIdeology: Too obscure to document as a position set: the scholarship (Laruni 2015, Amone on Acholi identity) studies how Acholi ethnic identity formed and was used to bargain with or resist the Ugandan state, not a programme of positions, and no defining text names Acholi nationalism and states what it holds. The only position texts found (an Acholi Parliamentary Group land statement, a UN land-dispute study) concern land policy and do not name the ideology.

sources.title: Regional and ethnic identities: the Acholi of Northern Uganda, 1950-1968 (Laruni, Journal of Eastern African Studies 9(2), 2015), catalogue abstract
